actualThreeBoundedChanges.ownSubjectRationaleEn: Comparing repayment maturity and liquidity or financing rights/control against expressly supplied financial objectives does not universally require mastery of a whole static/dynamic investment-method comparison. The actually complete50k maturity and30k equity/reserve cases provide counterexamples without discounted cash-flow modelling. Investment appraisal remains a separate assessable target, not automatically mastered or suppressed.

A connected investigation with different appropriate business-analysis tools need not universally require the full financial-and-profitability-ratio plus spreadsheet competence. The actual café SWOT/linearBE and repair SWOT/expressly defined ratios cases show concrete investigative tool use without spreadsheet preparation;200/300 forecasting or general insolvency mastery is not smuggled in. The more specialised ratio/spreadsheet goal remains independently assessable.

Identifying possible business strategies and explaining information, resources, prioritisation and feedback does not universally require full ratio/spreadsheet mastery. Both actually whole strategy cases concern market/product/capacity choices with definitions to be supplied, without ratio calculations. The existing company-objectives/stakeholder prerequisite b215 is retained because strategy still needs a concrete objective frame.
